# Communes chapter, sgt1925 (ark bpt6k9105650k): "Finances municipales: b) Emprunts communaux" (Tunis bond
# loans) and "c) Emprunts contractés à la Caisse des Prêts Communaux". Two-page spreads, views 52-53, 54-55 and 56-57. View 52 (left page of the first spread: Tunis bonds and the Caisse loans of Tunis, Béja, Bizerte, Ferryville) is a black image in the Gallica scan, so that spread is not transcribed.
# Read on native-resolution crops of the page images; Gallica OCR used only to locate the lines.
# Format: '@<table> view=<left view> view2=<right view> page=<left page> year=<exercice>', 'cols:', then
# '= <commune heading as printed>' and rows '<date of the loan as printed> | values', 'Totaux | ...' per commune.
# Money: francs with centimes after '.', no thousands separator; printed » = 0; 'NNN.xx' = franc part legible,
# centimes hidden in the binding; durations in years ("ans"); interest rate in percent ("3 75" = 3.75, "3 1/2" = 3.5).
# @tunis_bonds cols: dur rate cap_net cap_nom int_due cap_due int_paid_year cap_paid_year int_paid_before
#   cap_paid_before int_paid_total cap_paid_total int_lapsed cap_lapsed int_outstanding cap_outstanding
#   (columns 2-17 of the table).
# @caisse cols: dur cap_net cap_nom rate annuity due paid_year paid_before paid_total arrears amortised
#   remaining (columns 2-13 of the table).
@caisse view=54 view2=55 page=30 year=1925
cols: dur cap_net cap_nom rate annuity due paid_year paid_before paid_total arrears amortised remaining
